audience: Romanian businesses and accountants who issue invoices and proformas in SmartBill Cloud

useCases.title: Check invoice payments and proforma invoicing status
useCases.text: The AI reads the total, paid amount, unpaid amount and paid flag of an invoice. It can also show whether a proforma was invoiced and which invoices came from it.

useCases.title: Check stock levels per warehouse
useCases.text: The AI reads stock quantities per warehouse as of a date, filtered by warehouse, product name or code, and lists the warehouses. It needs the SmartBill stock module.

useCases.title: Look up clients, suppliers and products
useCases.text: The AI searches clients and suppliers by name, internal code or CIF, and lists products and services with price, unit and VAT rate. It then opens one record for details.

useCases.title: Check document series and VAT rates
useCases.text: The AI lists the document series with their next number, and the VAT rates configured in the account. You need these before you make a document.

useCases.title: Draft an invoice or proforma for a client
useCases.text: The AI creates an invoice or proforma with product or service lines, or an invoice from a proforma. By default it saves a draft with no number for review in SmartBill Cloud.

useCases.title: Record a payment, email, cancel or reverse an invoice
useCases.text: The AI records a payment against issued invoices, emails an invoice or proforma, cancels an invoice, or issues a storno to reverse one. Emails and storno cannot be undone.
